text.p: Tropical storm Marco has formed in the western Caribbean about 360 miles southwest of Kingston Jamaica. This system will become an increasing risk to shipping today and Wednesday as winds increase from 40 mph to 55 mph during this time. It is expected to track across Jamaica and far eastern Cuba later in the period. Heavy rains could lead to flooding in these areas during that time and also across Hispanola. Winds would be some problem near and just east of the storm track but the strongest risk is from flooding rains.

A strong storm system has moved to southwest England at midday Tuesday. This system should make its way eastward to Benelux, northwest Germany and Denmark during Wednesday. Strong winds will impact shipping in the Bay of Biscay, the English Channel and the southern North Sea during this period. Coastal beach errosion is also expected for northwest France and the southern British Isles.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
